description: A premium, editorial portfolio website built for a high-end wedding photography duo. It features custom FLIP lightbox transitions and a DOM virtualization system to render galleries of up to 1,000 high-res photos at 60fps.
seoDescription: Adam & Ewa is a premium commercial website built from scratch by creative developer Tomasz Szmajda (ITom) for a wedding photography and videography duo based in Poland. The project replaces a decade-old legacy site with a bespoke, template-free experience built on React Router v7, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Lenis smooth scroll, and Sanity headless CMS. It features an asymmetrical scattered gallery layout with parallax drift, FLIP-technique shared element lightbox transitions, scroll-driven typography animations with progressive blur reveal, and a custom double-layer DOM virtualization system using IntersectionObserver. This virtualization enables smooth 60fps scrolling through galleries containing up to 1000 high-resolution wedding photos — a massive engineering challenge solved entirely in frontend code. Images are optimized through Sanity's CDN with device-responsive sizing, WebP/AVIF auto-formatting, and LQIP blur-up placeholders. The site scores a perfect 100/100 on Google Lighthouse. Typography combines Cormorant Garamond serif headings with Inter body text on a warm eggshell background. The client manages all content independently through Sanity Studio.
seoTitle: Adam & Ewa – Premium Photography Website with Smooth Animations
